answer: Adversary-funded challenge bonds resist sybils: anyone may dispute an identity's claimed work by posting a matching bond, and an impartial ruling transfers the loser's bond to the winner. Fraud is actively hunted, not merely audited, since honest challengers profit by catching fakes. A swarm minting clones across the mesa each exposes a slashable bond to any watching raven, and bounty-seekers comb the field like yarrow pickers. Expected loss per fake is the bond times the chance of being challenged and losing, so raising bonds or challenger rewards prices mass cheating out.
